narr: There were gusty winds for different parts of Utah and flash flooding in southern Utah.
ev: Snow Canyon State Park reported flash flooding. Campers were displaced from the campsite, multiple waterfalls were observed, and employees had to wait on water to recede at a low water crossing as the flowing water was up to car door handles.

Zion National Park officials reported multiple waterfalls and high flows in multiple slot canyons in Zion Canyon. The North Fork Virgin River near Springdale gauge indicated a spike from 58 cfs to 251 cfs in five minutes, peaking at 264 cfs. Around this time, Zion National Park rangers reported elevated flows and waterfalls in canyons continued. The East Fork Virgin near Glendale gauge peaked at 357 cfs, after starting at 47 cfs.
A trained spotter reported a large flash flood with water lapping the bottom of the U.S. Highway 89 bridge over the Paria River.
The Dirty Devil Above Poison Springs Near Hanksville gauge peaked at 1052 cfs, likely indicative of flash flooding through most of the slot canyons to the north.
